Global Youth Innovation Challenge

The Global Youth Innovation Challenge is open to students in grades 9-12 from any country.

Teams of up to 4 students may register. Individual entries are also accepted.

Registration fee: Free to enter — no cost to apply.

Submission deadline: October 3, 2026. Late entries will not be accepted.

Prize: Winning teams receive a $10,000 grand prize and mentorship from industry experts.

Eligibility: open to secondary school students aged 14-18 worldwide.
